sheets.title: ELECTRICAL PIER ONE-LINE DIAGRAM PIER 15
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet one-line diagram for a naval pier (Pier 15) medium-voltage electrical system modification. Shows three transformer banks serving three switchboard sections (TB1 and TB2 on west side, TB3 on east side). Power source is 23 kV wye overhead service via a deadend pole with S&C dropout-rupter switch, 35 kV shielded cable underground run, and a 6-way SF6 ground-mounted switch at the head of the pier. West side: two 3000 KVA 23kV/277-480V SS pad-mounted transformers (FR3 fluid, bayonet fusing) each feeding a 4000A 277/480V switchboard (12×400A + 1×1200A branch breakers with LSIG trip). East side: one 2500 KVA 23kV/277-480V SS transformer feeding a 3000A switchboard (8×400A branch breakers). Ship-to-shore connections via turtle backs H (west, #1 and #2) and N (east). Shore power cables by others. 1200A breaker in west switchboards provides temporary generator connection point. Legend items A through N with N=NOT USED. Drawing stamped FINAL SUBMITTAL 03/29/2023. Firm is Bowman Foster & Associates Inc. — not BFA per se unless BFA is the subconsultant or this project is attributed to them via other means. Title block shows Project No. 20-035. File path in drawing margin references NAVFAC context. Scale: AS NOTED (diagram, not to scale).

electrical: 23 kV medium-voltage overhead service feed from deadend pole with S&C dropout-rupter switch (34.5 kV rated, 200 kV BIL, 600A) and 27 kV arrestors
35 kV rated 500 kcmil CU shielded underground cables in 6-inch conduit
S&C 6-way 25 kV SF6 ground-mounted switch at pier head
Above-ground junction box at pier head for underground-to-surface transition
TB1 (West Side): 3000 KVA SS pad-mounted transformer 23000/277/480V, FR3 fluid, 15% fans, bayonet fusing — ship-to-shore power
TB1 switchboard: 4000A 277/480V, 4000A main breaker, 12×400A 3-pole branch breakers, 1×1200A 3-pole temp gen connection breaker; LSIG trip provisions
12 sets of 3×600 KCMIL CU conductors in wireway (TB1 transformer to switchboard)
Turtle back #1 or #2: 12×400A 3-pole connections for ship-to-shore service (west)
TB2 (West Side): identical configuration to TB1
TB3 (East Side): 2500 KVA SS pad-mounted transformer 23000/277/480V, FR3 fluid, bayonet fusing — utility power
8 sets of 3×600 KCMIL CU conductors in wireway (TB3 transformer to switchboard)
Turtle back (east): 8×400A 3-pole connections for utility service
